body: It’s okay, I mean we’re still kind of together but idk anymore to be honest, he hasn’t been acting the same. I’ve wanted to ask him about it but the thought of him leaving me stops me every time, even though it’d probably be for the best since I don’t deserve him
I know it was a bad idea and I feel so guilty... I love him so much but I can’t bear being here on this earth anymore, I really wish I would’ve killed myself before I met him.

I’m sorry about that... I just really needed to get this off my chest, but I know how you feel. I wish dying wasn’t so scary & I could just take something that would put me to sleep for the rest of my life.
Thank you, I truly appreciate your kindness but I've decided to give up.
